items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this actively exploited vulnerability.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. It also advises applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: Part of APSB26-92, this critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Threat actors have reportedly attempted to exploit this in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-92, is a stored XSS flaw that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: Included in APSB26-92, this high-severity stored XSS vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability, affecting Adobe Commerce B2B and addressed in APSB26-92, could enable a security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: Resolved in APSB26-92, this high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security feature bypass and requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, which could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, that could enable a security feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: This low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-92, could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
